elements.name: Manage Narro's local Windows appearance and shortcuts.
Choose which Windows work area owns the Focus Panel.
Anchor the Focus Panel to the selected monitor's work-area edge.
System follows your current Windows light or dark preference.
System theme — Follow your Windows color mode
Dark theme — Use Narro's dark surfaces
Light theme — Use Narro's light surfaces
Start Narro automatically when Windows starts.
Keep task timing quieter until you hover or focus a task.
Hide task EST and Time Taken
Recognize a supported estimate suffix when creating a task.
Blank uses the current Windows/WebView timezone (Europe/Athens).
Use sprint and break durations instead of task EST for new Focus starts.
Length of each Pomodoro work interval.
Automatic break length after a completed sprint.
Used by Start Break in Focus and the in-app shortcut.
Scroll long live-task titles instead of keeping them truncated.
Enable periodic local reminders while focused.
How often a timed task alert may occur.
Choose a bundled local Narro sound. Starting another preview stops the current one.
Allow the timer surface to use the documented alert flash.
Allow local Windows notification alerts for relevant timer events.
Choose the bundled local sound used by notification-alert preferences.
Enable local reminders for scheduled tasks.
Lead time before the scheduled task.
Enable a local completion moment after a successful task transition.
Optional nested success-screen decoration; exact source visuals remain a fidelity follow-up.
Choose the bundled local sound for the success-screen completion moment.
Global shortcuts work both inside and outside Narro. Disable any chord you do not want Narro to register.
Bring the Narro Main window to the front from any Windows app.
Switch the active Focus surface between Panel and Floating Timer.
Bring attention to the Floating Timer when Focus is active.
